title: Abstract algebra and symmetry
prerequisites: M4 and M6; P7a for physical examples.
purpose: Elective: use groups and representations to understand symmetry in quantum mechanics and gauge theory.

blocks.deliverable: Week 7 proof midterm; analyze an orbit and stabilizer.
Calculate generators and commutators for rotations.
Present the representation and complete the final.

project: Construct a finite group representation and connect its algebra to a simple physical symmetry.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
